description: This file contains functions related to handling object IDs (OIDs) in the context of testing, including parsing hex representations into OID structures and setting up hash algorithms.

methods.name: int cl_setup_hash_algo(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns the hash algorithm used for object IDs, defaulting to SHA-1 or as specified by the environment variable.

methods.name: void cl_parse_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id structure using the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: void cl_parse_any_oid(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Public function to parse any hex string into an object_id, selecting the hash algorithm based on configuration.

ctags.name: cl_parse_oid
ctags.signature: (const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
